reason: A browser UI enhancement that displays an animated cat and plays a synthesized meow when conversation turns finish, using a local status endpoint and browser configuration.

summaries.zh: 在对话回合结束时，在 DeepSeek Harness 网页底部显示跑过的猫动画并播放合成的喵声。
summaries.en: Displays a running cat animation at the bottom of the DeepSeek Harness web UI and plays a synthesized meow whenever a conversation turn ends.

capabilities: Modifies the web UI with a fixed click-through animation layer
Tracks completed conversation turns through a local plugin status endpoint
Polls the local status endpoint from the browser
Generates and plays synthesized audio in the browser
